model weight, and bundled asset. It is regenerated with `make licenses` and checked in CI.

## Copyleft notes

None of the packages below is vendored or bundled in the mr-audio-smith wheel or sdist; they are
installed by the user's package manager. Container images that include them must ship the
corresponding license texts and source offers (see docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md, residual risks).

- mutagen (GPL-2.0-or-later) is a core runtime dependency used for audio tags. It is imported, not modified.
- phonemizer-fork (GPL-3.0-or-later) and espeakng-loader (bundles espeak-ng, GPL-3.0-or-later) come only from the optional `kokoro` extra.
- pykakasi (GPL-3.0-or-later) comes only from the optional `chatterbox` extra.
- soxr (LGPL-2.1-or-later) and num2words (LGPL) are dynamically linked or imported, unmodified.
- These exceptions are recorded with reasons in the ALLOWLIST of scripts/check-licenses.py.

## Platform-specific wheels

On Linux GPU installs, PyTorch pulls NVIDIA CUDA runtime wheels (nvidia-*, cuda-*) under the NVIDIA
proprietary redistribution terms. They are absent from the macOS table above and are not bundled by this project.
